executiveSummary: The latest technology news highlights the growing importance of AI and its applications, with a focus on safety and business use cases. Hardware releases, such as Apple's new HomeOS and Nacon's PS5 controller, also make headlines. Industry shifts, including the acquisition of Warner Bros. by Skydance, and supply chain issues, like AT&T's iPhone 18 Pro Max issues, are also reported.

takeaways.title: AI safety and business applications
takeaways.description: The White House has signed an AI safety pledge, and OpenAI's Dot agent is being used for enterprise software and can also order dinner, highlighting the growing focus on AI safety and business use cases.

takeaways.title: Hardware releases
takeaways.description: Apple's new HomeOS and Nacon's PS5 controller with a built-in screen are new hardware releases that make headlines, expanding the range of devices that can be controlled by AI and other technologies.

worthWatching: The increasing importance of AI safety and its applications in business and enterprise use cases.
engineeringPerspective: The use of AI in controlling devices, such as Apple's HomeOS and Nacon's PS5 controller, highlights the potential for automation and convenience in various applications.
The growing focus on supply chain issues, such as AT&T's iPhone 18 Pro Max issues, underscores the importance of reliable and secure technology infrastructure.
